library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-boot-opentelemetry's logging.otlp package (OtlpLoggingAutoConfiguration and its gRPC/HTTP exporter customizers) references io.opentelemetry:opentelemetry-exporter-otlp types that are not a declared or transitive dependency of the library's own POM. The already-merged sibling spring-boot-micrometer-tracing-opentelemetry:4.1.1 (which itself depends on spring-boot-opentelemetry) hit the identical gap for its analogous tracing-exporter customizers and required adding this exact coordinate as testImplementation to exercise them. Without it, OtlpLoggingAutoConfiguration's @ConditionalOnClass guard silently skips activation, producing near-zero coverage on that package rather than a build failure.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Exercise the core SDK autoconfiguration (OpenTelemetrySdkAutoConfiguration, OpenTelemetryProperties, OpenTelemetryResourceAttributes) and the logging autoconfiguration (OtlpLoggingAutoConfiguration, OtlpLoggingProperties, OtlpGrpcLogRecordExporterBuilderCustomizer, OtlpHttpLogRecordExporterBuilderCustomizer, Transport) via ApplicationContextRunner + withPropertyValues under the management.opentelemetry.* and management.logging.export.otlp.* property namespaces, following the pattern already used in spring-boot-micrometer-tracing-opentelemetry's test. No environment variable or system property is required: management.opentelemetry.enabled and management.logging.export.enabled both default to enabled/match-if-missing, so the autoconfiguration activates with no external config. OpenTelemetryEnvironmentVariableEnvironmentPostProcessor can be tested by constructing a MockEnvironment/ConfigurableEnvironment directly in test code and invoking postProcessEnvironment, without needing real OS-level OTEL_* environment variables.
risks: Do not confuse this artifact with org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-opentelemetry, which ships no class files (metadata already marks it not-for-native-image) — the issue's own title ('spring-boot-opentelemetry') is correct but the body gives no detail, so this distinction is easy to miss.
